info.name: TiDB Cloud API Keys Data App API Keys API

params.name: dataAppId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Data App.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default is 100, maximum is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Pagination token returned from a previous list request to retrieve the next page.

items.docs: Returns all API keys scoped to a specific Data App. These keys are used to authenticate calls to the custom endpoints defined within the Data App and are separate from organization-level API keys.

info.name: Create a Data App API key

params.name: dataAppId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Data App.

items.docs: Creates a new API key scoped to a specific Data App. Specify the key description, role (READ_ONLY or READ_AND_WRITE), rate limit in requests per minute, and optional expiration settings. The private key is only returned at creation time.
